description:
Search services across all businesses: «маникюр с покрытием до 2000 ₽ рядом с метро Сокол с рейтингом
от 4.5». Separate rating bounds for the salon, for the service itself and for its masters (a master bound
matches when at least one master performing the service is rated within it). Price bounds apply to the
service price (RUB). Each item: serviceId (for get_available_slots), name, durationMinutes, price,
rating, masters with their ratings, the salon (slug, name, address, rating, distanceKm) and bookingUrl.

city.description: Only businesses whose address contains this text, e.g. a city «Казань». Ignored when a place is given.

lat.description: Latitude of the place to search around (instead of `near`).

lng.description: Longitude of the place to search around (instead of `near`).

maxMasterRating.description: Some master of the service rated at most (1–5).

maxPrice.description: Service price at most this, RUB.

maxServiceRating.description: Rating of this service at most (1–5).

minMasterRating.description: Some master of the service rated at least (1–5).

minPrice.description: Service price at least this, RUB.

minReviews.description: With a rating bound: at least this many reviews behind each bounded rating (default 1).

minServiceRating.description: Rating of this service at least (1–5).

near.description: A place to search around: address, metro station or landmark, with the city — «Москва, метро Сокол», «Казань, Баумана 10». Used for «рядом», «около», «недалеко», «поблизости».

query.description: What the service is, in Russian: «маникюр», «стрижка», «массаж спины», «окрашивание».

radiusKm.description: Search radius around the place, km (default 3, max 50; ~1 for «в шаговой доступности»).

sort.description: Order. Default: distance when a place is given, otherwise the service's rating.

name: search_services
title: Поиск услуг
